title: Spicy Moroccan Eggs with Chickpeas
description: Harissa-spiced chickpea and vegetable stew with poached eggs, finished with coriander.
steps: Soften the onion and garlic, stir in harissa, ground coriander, stock and chickpeas, then mash a third of the chickpeas.
Add the tomatoes and courgette, simmer until tender, then fold in the spinach.
Make hollows in the mixture, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 2 minutes.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food spicy Moroccan eggs

notes: BBC Good Food's own nutritionist notes protein at breakfast keeps you fuller for longer and steadies blood sugar — this one delivers both from a plant-forward base.
